# Offline K-FIND XLSX reader third-party notices

Browser-only, self-hosted bundle: `read-excel-file@9.3.14` from the published npm distribution. Exactly compared against both the jsDelivr and unpkg version-pinned browser bundle; the upstream sourceMappingURL comment was omitted because no map is shipped.

Transitive browser components include fflate and saxen, with preserved MIT notices below. The package also lists MIT-licensed `worker-f` as a dependency (https://gitlab.com/catamphetamine/worker-f). No runtime third-party CDN requests or SaaS API key are required for parsing. The attached K-FIND spreadsheet itself is not bundled into this site.
